svg.title: One function, four ways to run it
svg.desc: The train function in pipeline_steps/train_fn.py runs in four ways: called in the notebook, wrapped with remote as a SageMaker training job, as the entry script of a ModelTrainer training job in your container, and wrapped with step as a pipeline step. A native TrainingStep runs the same ModelTrainer in a pipeline.
svg.text: One function, four ways to run it
Run the file in your container
pipeline step, wired to the other
Notebook 03: a native TrainingStep runs the same ModelTrainer
preprocess(), evaluate(), and register() run the same way in the notebook, with remote(), and with step().
